name: midtown-drive-60s
notes: RingFold/NYCity: drive a taxi through Midtown traffic for ~60 s on the globe map (NYC_Planet streams NYC_Midtown in).
Confirmed in NYCity source/tools: /Game/Planet/Maps/NYC_Planet, ANycTrafficSystem::NumActive (BlueprintPure), ANycVehicle,
UNycGameplaySubsystem::SetAutosave/SetSlot, the HISM_taxi + PlayerStart labels and the E enter-vehicle key (tools/gameplay_test.py, on NYC_Midtown).
UNCONFIRMED: that HISM_taxi/PlayerStart keep those labels once NYC_Midtown is streamed under NYC_Planet; that traffic spawns
under -nullrhi; the traffic_active floor (5) and the 1500 cm distance are guesses -- tune after the first live run.

steps.until: unreal.GameplayStatics.get_actor_of_class(world, unreal.NycTrafficSystem) is not None and find('HISM_taxi') is not None

steps.do:
h = find('HISM_taxi').get_component_by_class(unreal.InstancedStaticMeshComponent)
start = find('PlayerStart').get_actor_location()
best = min(((unreal.MathLibrary.vector_distance(h.get_instance_transform(i, True).translation, start), i) for i in range(h.get_instance_count())))
xf = h.get_instance_transform(best[1], True)
side = unreal.MathLibrary.get_right_vector(unreal.Rotator(roll=0, pitch=0, yaw=xf.rotation.rotator().yaw))
player.set_actor_location(xf.translation + side * 200 + unreal.Vector(0, 0, 100), False, True)

counters.name: traffic_active
counters.expr: (lambda t: t.num_active() if t else -1)(unreal.GameplayStatics.get_actor_of_class(world, unreal.NycTrafficSystem))
